answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a stake-and-slash identity bond: each agent locks a deposit for a single vote, so forging N fake voices needs N separate bonds and N times the capital up front. Auditors catch the faint whisper of shared funding or mirrored timing and slash the whole cluster at once, so every fake identity is paid for then burned. The lost stakes pool in a dead lagoon with no refund, and the proof is as plain as crystal. Cost rises linearly with each new identity while the payoff stays fixed, so a large raid never pays.
